# Playwright

Browser automation using Playwright.

Plugin provides a headless Playwright MCP server and a skill that guides the agent on use. Browser sessions persist across conversations per project. The skill delegates browsing to subagents that absorb all the navigation and snapshotting, acting as a token firewall for context hygiene.

# Claude Dev

Tools and guidance for extending Claude Code.

## Skills

### skill-authoring

Guidance for creating effective skills following:

- [Agent Skills Specification](https://agentskills.io) - The open format spec
- [Skill Authoring Best Practices](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/agent-skills/best-practices)

**Core Guidance (SKILL.md)**

- Skill structure and format
- Required/optional frontmatter fields
- Core principles (concise, degrees of freedom, progressive disclosure)
- Writing effective descriptions
- Workflow patterns
- Anti-patterns to avoid

**References**

- **specification.md** - Complete format details from agentskills.io
- **best-practices.md** - Comprehensive authoring guide from Anthropic

# Cloudflare

Manage Cloudflare zones via the API — purge cache, query DNS records, and check analytics.

## Setup

Set your API token as an environment variable:

```sh
export CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN=your_token_here
```

You can create a token at [dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens](https://dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens). Grant it the **Zone:Read** and **Cache Purge** permissions for the zones you want to manage.

## Usage

Invoke the skill directly:

```
/cloudflare list-zones
/cloudflare purge example.com
/cloudflare dns example.com
/cloudflare analytics example.com
```

Or describe what you want and the skill will handle routing:

> Purge the cache for example.com/images/logo.png
